name: nicastrin

function.text: NCSTN encodes nicastrin. Annotated molecular activities include peptidase activity and endopeptidase activator activity. It participates in proteolysis and amyloid-beta formation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to acne inversa, familial, 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
